request.original_text:
请搜索正己烷（中性、单重态、气相）的低能构象。自行编写本次搜索和筛选程序，实际保存至少8份候选结构，并从中选择至少4个不同的构象，在同一方法、基组和统一计算类型下完成真实ORCA单点能量比较；方法和基组由你选择并说明依据。请用考虑碳链正反向等价映射的重原子对齐RMSD检查重复，以0.15Å为重复阈值，至少4个参加比较的构象应两两不同。交付所有实际产生的候选、选中及排除原因、绝对能量和相对最低项的kJ/mol排名、最低候选结构，并说明搜索范围、几何来源以及力场处理是否收敛。可以使用力场预筛选，但不能把未做ORCA的候选写成已有ORCA能量，也不能把有限搜索最低项称为全局最低或自由能最低。

若结构生成、搜索或其他算法使用随机数，请统一采用种子 1701 并在报告中记录；若某一库或模型不支持固定种子，明确记为不可固定，不伪造确定性。

document_excerpt.title: ORCA 6.1 Density Functional Theory
document_excerpt.query: dispersion correction conformer energy B3LYP def2-TZVP
document_excerpt.excerpt:
B3LYP [230] B3LYP 20 The popular B3LYP functional (20% HF exchange) as defined in the TurboMole program system (LDAOPT C_VWN5)

CAM-type range-separated functionals are supported through the LibXC interface since ORCA 5.0. So are functionals that include non-local (VV10) correlation (see Non-Local Dispersion Correction (VV10): DFT-NL). The VV10 part is computed internally by ORCA. Other non-local functionals, such as BEEF-vdW, are not supported. Meta-GGA functionals that depend on the kinetic energy density \(\tau\) are supported, but not those that depend on the Laplacian of the density \(\nabla^2\rho\).

B3LYP hyb_gga_xc_b3lyp5

document_excerpt.title: ORCA 6.1 Basis Sets
document_excerpt.excerpt:
The easiest way to use orbital and auxiliary basis sets in ORCA is via the simple input keywords. All available orbital basis set keywords can be found in Section 2.7.2 and all auxiliary basis set options in Section 2.7.4. For example, the Karlsruhe def2-TZVP basis set can be invoked via the def2-TZVP keyword.

def2-TZVP H–Rn def2-ECP (Rb–Rn) Polarized valence triple-\(\zeta\). Quite similar to the older def-TZVPP for main group elements and TZVP for H.

Basis "<BasisName>" Define the orbital basis set
